# StackBlitz

> > StackBlitz provides instant browser-based development environments powered by WebContainers technology, along with Bolt.new, an AI-powered web app generation platform.

StackBlitz runs Node.js directly in the browser using WebAssembly, enabling full-stack development without local setup. The platform includes Codeflow IDE, embeddable SDK, GitHub integration, and enterprise solutions for teams.

## Key Topics

- WebContainers
- Bolt.new
- Browser-based IDE
- Instant dev environments
- WebAssembly runtime
- Node.js in browser
- Codeflow
- AI code generation
- GitHub integration
- StackBlitz SDK
- Enterprise Server
- Team collaboration
- Code embedding
- Online development
